source_text: In a 2006 study from Birnin Kudu, northern Nigeria, gishiri cuts were documented as a contributing factor to VVF among women seeking repair, highlighting the procedure's role in non-obstetric fistula formation through iatrogenic trauma during self-treatment for gynecological complaints. [5]
